blocks.text: Every stage after reading works on this schema. Agreeing on it in the first two hours lets the whole team build in parallel.

LayerResponsibility
FrontendMobile-friendly web app: upload, language selector, mic button, checklist view, highlighted original document.
Backend APIPipeline orchestration (Vision, extraction, action engine, explanation, TTS) and session storage so follow-up questions keep context.
Sarvam servicesVision for reading, chat model for extraction and reasoning, Saaras for speech-to-text, Bulbul for text-to-speech, translation APIs.
Validation moduleCode checks for dates, amounts and ID formats against the extracted text, to catch hallucinations.
Evaluation script10 to 15 realistic documents with expected fields, producing accuracy numbers for the demo.
• Evidence: every extracted field links to the highlighted region of the original document.
• Confidence flags: blurry scans or uncertain fields are marked instead of guessed.
• Grounded answers: follow-up answers use only the document, with a not-mentioned fallback.
- Not legal advice: the app explains documents and points users to the official office or helpline for decisions.
- **Privacy:** documents are not stored beyond the session and are deleted afterward; this is stated in the pitch.
